A (i) 0.692(62.93) + 0.308(64.93) = 63.55 amu. (ii) Two more neutrons.

B (i) \(\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}\) has a bigger charge, so it pulls harder on the negative oxygen end of water. (ii) \(\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}\) has more protons.

C [OH⁻] = 0.0080 M, pOH = 2.10, pH = 11.90.

D (2.0 × 10⁻³)(40.0/100.0) = 8.0 × 10⁻⁴ M.

E (i) \(K_{sp} = [\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}][\mathrm{F^-}]^2\). (ii) \(Q = (8.0\times10^{-4})(1.8\times10^{-3})^2 = 2.6\times10^{-9}\). (iii) Q > Ksp, so a precipitate forms.

F It decreases because H⁺ reacts with F⁻ to make HF, so more \(\mathrm{CaF_{2}}\) dissolves.
